A.note: Best-balanced frame. Rock is richly textured with green vegetation and a believable cliff face. The sea has good colour and depth, and the apron and airport foreground read plausibly. The sky is a little plain, and the town is a dense but uniform grid.

B.note: Almost the same as A, with a more saturated blue sea and a distant headland that adds depth. The sky and atmosphere are slightly cleaner. The foreground apron is bland, and the rock is a bit more uniformly green.

C.note: Hazy, desaturated look with a beige foreground. The foreground blocks look like game pieces. The rock is flatter, with less vegetation and contrast. Atmospheric depth is good, but the image lacks punch.

D.note: Warm, hazy light with a textured rock and some red-roof accents. The vegetation and field patches look blotchy and Minecraft-like. Hard, saturated colour patches in the foreground (orange and red) look like game pieces. Atmosphere is softer, but the sea is duller.

why: B and A share the strongest rock, vegetation and sea, with B slightly ahead on colour separation and a distant headland for depth. D is more atmospheric but blotchy. C is washed out and flat.
top_fix_for_best: Break up the bland grey apron and the uniform town grid. Add airport detail (parked aircraft, runway markings, taxiway lights, vehicles) and varied roof colours and heights. Then add a soft low-angle sun with long shadows and a bit of haze on the rock to give the frame cinematic depth.
